reviewFlags.issue: X9F-6 appears on the Aristos product page (as X9F-6 בורדו) and on the Brafman importer page as an option of the OXFORD 90. The Dutch retailer page names the same model as a black gas version. The model is current in the Israeli listing (the Aristos page is under דגמי 2026).
Aristos gives total connected power 15.10 KW, which no second site confirms. The Dutch listing gives a connection value of 2.9 kW, a different measure. Check against the manufacturer sheet.
Sources conflict: Aristos says maximum 255 °C, the Dutch retailer says the oven runs from 50 to 265 °C.
Sources conflict on oven interior depth: Aristos says 35 ס״מ, Brafman says 33 ס״מ.
Aristos says 6 gas burners including a 4.50 KW brass wok burner. Brafman says 5 burners plus 1 brass wok burner (same total). The Dutch listing gives 6 burners too.
Aristos says 255 °C; the Dutch retailer reports 50 to 265 °C.
15.10 KW total power comes from one retailer only; check against the manufacturer sheet.
X9F-6 is sold in several colors (בורדו on Aristos, black in NL); the catalog name does not state the body color.
Sources disagree on interior depth (35 vs 33 ס״מ); not published.
